newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bomb scare outside HK legislature building.
newsitem.headline: Bomb scare outside HK legislature building.

text.p: A road next to the building housing Hong Kong's legislature was closed on Wednesday after the discovery of a parcel suspected to be a bomb.

A police spokesman said by telephone authorities had closed Chater Road next to the Legislative Council building, where Financial Secretary Donald Tsang will give the 1997/98 budget speech this afternoon.
A man believed to be a bomb disposal expert was examining the parcel, a witness at the scene told Reuters.
About 20 policemen and a fire-engine were also on the scene, the witness said.
